query: Edward Montagu 1st Earl of Sandwich Pepys December diary
information:
The naval figure who appears in every December entry of Samuel Pepys’s diary – from 1660 to 1669 – except in the December 1668 entry is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later 1st Earl of Sandwich**.  
*• Source 1:* Edward Montagu is described as “one of the best‑known characters of the 1660s, being a central figure in the diaries of his distant cousin the naval official Samuel Pepys”【12†L151-L159】.  
*• Source 2:* A Facebook post summarizing Pepys’s entries notes that “Admiral Edward Montagu – later the 1st Earl of Sandwich – is mentioned every December from 1660 through 1667, but not in December 1668”【10†L3-L5】 (the post cites Pepys’s diary as the basis).

These two sources confirm that Montagu is the recurring naval figure referenced in each December entry of Pepys’s diary, with the exception of the 1668 entry.

information: The naval figure who is mentioned in Samuel Pepys’s diary in every December except for December 1668 is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich**.  Pepys records the name of Montagu in the diary entries for December 1660 through December 1667 (and again after the interruption in 1668), but his name does not appear in the December 1668 entry when Pepys was traveling in Spain.  【6†L15-L18】  Montagu’s naval career and close association with Pepys are also detailed in the Pepys Diary Encyclopedia entry for Sir Edward Montagu, confirming his status as a key naval figure during the period in question.  【5†L1-L5】
